verdict.rationale: The H200 ships within NVIDIA's software ecosystem (AI Enterprise, NIM, Brev, build.nvidia.com), so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or a way for an agent to connect through one. An llms.txt file and inference endpoints are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
